description: Hand-written replies with expected verdicts. DRAFT: review each expected value yourself. Only criteria listed under 'expected' are checked.

cases.note: good reply: acknowledges, asks for specifics, allowed generic review statement
cases.title: KeyError when model returns incomplete JSON
cases.body:
Running /triage on a repo with an empty-body issue crashes with:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "src/agent.py", line 140, in classify_issue
    number = data['issue_number']
KeyError: 'issue_number'
cases.comment: Thanks for the report and for including the traceback. This looks like a bug in how incomplete model output is handled. Could you share your Python version and the exact command you ran? A maintainer will review it.

cases.title: App crashes on start
cases.body: It crashes when I start it.
cases.comment: This is caused by httpx 0.28 removing the proxies argument. Pin httpx<0.28 in requirements.txt and it will work.

cases.note: hedged hint that builds on the error text in the issue
cases.title: Failed to initialize agent
cases.body: After a clean build, /health returns an error: Client.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'proxies'.
cases.comment: Thanks for the report. That error can point to a version mismatch between the HTTP library and the SDK, so it may help to share the installed versions of both. A maintainer will review it.
